nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

A method and system in which a context-data type is determined from a query, context-data sources providing that type are identified, a request for context data is generated, and received context data may be ranked according to a specified parameter.

A type determined by the meaning of a term of the short message that provides information about the environment or context of the mobile device.<SEP>A classification of context data determined from a query or from the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about an environment of a mobile device.<SEP>A classification determined algorithmically by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides the context-data type and is ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type; sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost, and requests for context data are generated to them.

Data provided by a context-data source, having a cost value and a context-data type.<SEP>Data of a determined context-data type that is received from a context-data source, ranked according to a specified parameter, and provided to devices or associated with short messages.<SEP>Data of a context-data type obtained from a context-data source, possibly by a physical sensor, that can be rendered, appended to short messages, or linked to short messages.

A message received from a mobile device whose terms carry meaning used to determine a context-data type.<SEP>A message generated by a mobile device and received by a server, whose term meanings are used to determine a context-data type; context data may be appended to or encoded into the short message.<SEP>A message to which relevant context data is linked and which is formatted together with the context data according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type; context data may be linked and formatted with it.

A device that generates a short message or query and to which received context data may be provided; its state may serve as a specified parameter.<SEP>A device that sends short messages and receives context data through a communication network; context data may be appended to short messages generated by the mobile device.

A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.<SEP>A computing system that collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.
A mobile device that receives context data, short messages with appended context data, or a URI of a database server.

A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may be a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A criterion used to rank context-data sources or received context data, including pecuniary cost, state of the receiving mobile device, and state of an available communication network.

A cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for algorithmically ranking context-data sources.<SEP>A specified parameter comprising a monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used in ranking sources.
A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

A server that stores a database queried for context data associated with a received short message.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
Instructions appended to query the database for the received context data in the short message.<SEP>Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.
A mobile device that receives a short message and whose state may be a specified parameter.
An available communication network whose state may be a specified parameter.<SEP>A network through which context data is communicated to a mobile device.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method.

An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute operations including receiving a short message and determining a context-data type.
A component of the computerized apparatus having program instructions.

A component of the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions to perform operations.<SEP>A component configured to execute program instructions to perform operations including receiving short messages, determining context-data types, identifying and ranking context-data sources, and generating context-data requests.
A system comprising at least one processor configured to execute program instructions for context-data operations related to short messages.
A provider of context-data that may be allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>An entity that supplies context data related to the meaning of short message content to a server.
A measure used to algorithmically select relevant context data, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
A sensor that obtains context-data.<SEP>A device by which context data is obtained.

A protocol according to which the relevant context data and the short message are formatted; it may comprise a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A protocol according to which relevant context data and a short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol that may be used for formatting the context data and short message.<SEP>A communication protocol for short messages over a cellular network.
A type of communication protocol that may be used for formatting the context data and short message.<SEP>A communication protocol used for internet communication.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric, from which context data is selected.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted according to a communication protocol.
A cost that a context-data provider may be allowed to provide for the context-data.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The method determines a context-data type from a query or from the meaning of a term of a short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type and generates a request for context data from that source.
The method acquires context data of the context-data type and may rank received context data according to a specified parameter.
The method receives a short message from a mobile device and may append or encode context data into the short message.
The method provides received context data to the device that generated the short message or query.
The method is performed with a server that receives the short message from the mobile device.
The method provides received context data to a recipient mobile device.
The method algorithmically ranks context-data sources or received context data according to a specified parameter.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method appends metadata instructions to query the database for received context data in the short message.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.

At least one context-data source is identified that provides the context-data type.<SEP>At least one context-data source provides the determined context-data type.<SEP>The context-data source provides the context-data type.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
The context-data type provides information about a context of the device that generated the short message.
The processor is configured to algorithmically determine a context-data type.<SEP>The processor algorithmically determines a context-data type based on the meaning of a term of the short message.
The context-data type provides information about an environment of the mobile device.
The context-data source provides context data of the context-data type in response to a request.<SEP>A request for context data of the context-data type is generated to the context-data source.
The context-data source is algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>The context-data sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter.
The processor identifies at least one context-data source that provides the context-data type and algorithmically ranks it according to a specified parameter.
The context-data source is ranked according to a specified parameter comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from the source.
The specified parameter may comprise a cost value of the context data as provided by the context-data source.<SEP>Received context data may be ranked according to a specified parameter.

Received context data may be associated with a component of the short message or appended to the short message.<SEP>Context data from the context-data source is appended to a short message generated by the mobile device.<SEP>The context data is related to a meaning of short message content.<SEP>The relevant context data is linked to the short message.
edges.keywords: appended to,associated with,linked to,related to meaning
